faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.lead: Common questions about working together on freelance projects.

items.question: What type of projects do you take on?
items.answer: I work on full-stack web applications, Spring Boot backend systems, REST API development, database optimization, and high-performance Astro/React websites.

items.question: What is your availability for freelance work?
items.answer: I am available for contract roles, freelance projects, and technical consulting. Both milestone-based and monthly retainer arrangements are welcome.

items.question: How do we communicate during a project?
items.answer: I communicate via Slack, Email, and Google Meet/Zoom with regular async updates, staging links, and clear milestone check-ins.

items.question: How do you handle time zones?
items.answer: I am based in New Delhi (IST) and have 15+ years of experience working seamlessly with clients across the US, Europe, and Asia.

items.question: Do you provide fixed-price quotes?
items.answer: Yes. Once we discuss your requirements, I provide a clear scope, estimated timeline, and fixed price or milestone structure.

items.question: Do I get full ownership of the code?
items.answer: Yes, 100%. All source code, repositories, and documentation belong completely to you from day one.

items.question: Do you provide post-launch support?
items.answer: Yes, I offer ongoing maintenance, bug fixes, and feature enhancements after launch.

meta.title: Services — Full-Stack Web & Backend Engineering
meta.description: Freelance full-stack web development, Spring Boot backend systems, microservices, and database optimization. Reliable delivery for startups and businesses.

hero.description: Enterprise-grade engineering for startups and businesses: fast web applications, scalable Spring Boot backends, and rock-solid APIs.

design.heading: Web Apps & MVPs
paragraphs: I build high-performance web applications and SaaS MVPs from the ground up using modern technologies like Astro, React, and TypeScript.
Every web project is built with clean architecture, responsive layouts, fast load times, and search engine optimization so your business makes a strong impression.

included.text: Tailored for your business workflows and target audience.
Built with Astro & React for minimal JS and top Core Web Vitals.
Structured metadata, OpenGraph tags, and sitemaps built-in.
Flawless user experience across mobile, tablet, and desktop.
Full code ownership and easy maintenance.

development.heading: Spring Boot & APIs
paragraphs: Robust, secure, and scalable backend architecture powered by Java, Spring Boot, and Microservices.
Whether you need high-throughput REST APIs, automated batch jobs, payment integrations, or third-party webhooks, I build systems engineered for reliability.

included.text: Modular, resilient services with clean separation of concerns.
Scheduled jobs, data pipelines, and report generation.
JWT, OAuth2, and role-based access control.
Payment gateways, SMS, email providers, and webhooks.

performance.heading: Database & Tuning
paragraphs: Eliminating bottlenecks, reducing database query times, and scaling your system to handle peak traffic effortlessly.
I diagnose slow endpoints, tune PostgreSQL/MySQL queries, set up Redis caching layers, and fix memory issues to ensure high availability.

included.text: Indexing, execution plan analysis, and query refactoring.
In-memory caching for sub-millisecond response times.
Fixing memory leaks and optimizing thread concurrency.
Connection pooling, load balancing, and failure resilience.
Modernizing legacy codebases with comprehensive tests.

steps.title: 1. Discovery

steps.title: 3. Iterative Build
steps.description: Development in short sprint cycles with live staging previews and regular async updates.

steps.title: 4. Launch & Support
steps.description: Deployment to your cloud environment, complete code handover, and ongoing support.

faq.heading: Questions and Answers
faq.lead: Common questions before starting a project.

items.question: How do you charge for projects?
items.answer: I offer both fixed-price project quotes and hourly/monthly retainer arrangements depending on your preference and scope clarity.

items.question: How quickly can you start?
items.answer: Depending on current capacity, I can usually begin new client engagements within 1 to 2 weeks.

items.question: Do you work with non-technical founders?
items.answer: Yes! I explain technical choices in plain business terms and guide you through hosting, domain setup, and product decisions.

items.question: Will I work directly with you?
items.answer: Yes. You work 100% directly with me — a senior engineer with 15+ years experience, without junior handoffs.

items.question: Can you join an existing team as a contractor?
items.answer: Yes. I have extensive experience integrating into distributed Agile teams and enterprise engineering workflows.

items.question: Do you provide NDAs?
items.answer: Absolutely. I am happy to sign non-disclosure agreements before reviewing proprietary project details.
